narrative: Demand for PL2__MD886B0A is variable (CV=0.61, Gamma-like) with 93% active days and no trend. Lead times are moderately unstable (CV=0.40) with a bimodal delivery pattern suggesting two supplier modes. The combined-variance safety stock formula yields SS=634, nearly 4x the current ERP value of 156, properly protecting the 95% service level. A large consolidated EOQ of 3,027 is storage-capped to 2,029 units, cutting annual order events from 159 to 29 and saving $8,463/year.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Demand is near-continuous (93% active days) with moderate CV=0.61, making a continuous-review (r,Q) policy optimal: it responds immediately when stock hits the reorder point rather than waiting for a fixed review cycle, reducing stockout exposure during the variable 3-day lead time.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage cap binds the order quantity at 2,029 (vs EOQ 3,027), increasing order frequency slightly above the unconstrained optimum. If storage could be expanded by ~1,000 units, an additional ~$400/year saving is achievable. Current 100% utilization leaves no buffer for unexpected demand spikes.
research_insights.escalation_flag: none — MOQ (374) + SS (634) = 1,008 < max_storage (2,663); no MOQ-capacity conflict.
